invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Option, so the result should never be null.
If this table is itself a metadata table, the method immediately returns Option.empty().
If metadata table is not enabled and unavailable, the method only returns Option.empty().
The result is present if and only if the metadata table exists flag is set (per method code).
If autoDetectAndDeleteMetadataPartitions is true, the result will only be Option.empty() or Option.of(metadataWriter).
